items.label: Zoning view keeps rotation
items.description: Placeholder, to compare both ways (R18). Off (default) means the zoning view is North-up and fixed - Q/E do nothing while zoning. On means it starts at the camera's current facing and Q/E still rotate it.

items.label: Zoning create minimum square
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R18b), until the real stockpile layout design exists. Create zone is enabled only once the painted cells fit at least one solid square of this size.

items.label: Zoning undo steps
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R18b). How many strokes (press to release, paint or erase, including Erase all) Undo can go back.

items.label: Log zoning painting
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R18c). Debug: once per mouse hold while armed, logs whether the pointer counted as over UI (and which element), whether a ground cell was found, and how many cells the stroke changed. On by default in the Editor.
